say.text: Imagine a wooden ship. Over the years, every plank is replaced, one by one.

say.text: So, is it still the same ship?
That puzzle comes to us from the Greek writer Plutarch, nearly two thousand years ago.
Now someone collects all the old planks, and builds them back into a ship.
Which one is the real Ship of Theseus?

say.text: Hmm. Maybe both of them, or neither?
Philosophers still argue about it. And it is not really about ships.
Many of the cells in your body are replaced over the years.
So, are you still the same you?
